attrs.citation: Shawn Rasheed, Max McPhee, Lisa Patterson, Stephen MacDonell & Jens Dietrich, "Hidden Dependencies and Component Variants in SBOM-Based Software Composition Analysis" (arXiv 2604.21278), April 2026
hypotheses: the studied scanner population and ecosystem
attrs.note: VERIFIED 2026-08-24 — title, authors and date fetched from arXiv. ONLY THE ABSTRACT WAS READ; no quantitative finding from this paper is cited anywhere in this ledger, because none was obtained. It is used for the DIRECTION of the error only: a declared dependency graph UNDER-reports real dependence. That is the under-inclusion half of EMB-LINEAGE-WORKLIST and it is the half GPT-5.6's lineage traversal does not survive.
attrs.result: Code-level dependencies exist that are not represented as component-level dependencies ("hidden dependencies"), and component variants (clones) cannot be identified consistently across scanners. Both produce inconsistent vulnerability reporting and inconsistent handling of VEX statements.
